$comment: u0 — FROZEN CONTRACT for plan 136 typing-grace-gate. PM-authored (pij-fellow-whale, 2026-09-05) before fan-out. Field spellings derived from crates/core/src/model.rs (Event, Envelope, SeatDescriptor, DeliveryOutcome, DeliveryOrigin), crates/core/src/wire.rs (EVENT_VERSION, KNOWN_EVENT_KINDS) and crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs (delivery.inbox-ack emission) — none invented. u1/u2/u3 fill this contract; widening it is a stop-and-ask to the PM. Rust structs serialize snake_case (no rename_all on SeatDescriptor); spine events are {v, at, kind, seat, payload} with `seq` skipped on the wire (model.rs Event).

grace.$comment: Seam (a): ONE definition. `pub const DEFAULT_TYPING_GRACE_MS: u64 = 60_000;` in crates/core/src/delivery.rs, overridable by env PIJ_TYPING_GRACE_MS at the daemon only. The extension NEVER restates 60000 except as the `??` fallback used solely when the daemon omits the field (AC7).

event_kinds.$comment: Both kinds MUST be added to KNOWN_EVENT_KINDS in crates/core/src/wire.rs (u2), otherwise a reader decodes them as WireEvent::Unknown. Existing sibling kinds for style: delivery.outcome, delivery.inbox-ack, delivery.pointer-parked.

held.$comment: Spine event appended when the extension declines to inject a claimed row because the human typed inside the grace. `since_ms` is the Unix-ms timestamp of the LAST observed keystroke, not the hold's start.

released.$comment: Appended when the grace elapsed and the extension injected + acked the row. `at_ms` is when the release decision was taken; the delivery.inbox-ack that follows is the delivered receipt (origin reader-read).

hold_request.$comment: Seam (b): POST /v1/hold, bearer-authed exactly like /v1/register. Additive route. Body below; u1 calls it, u2 serves it. Serving it appends the `held` event above. Idempotent per (seat, msg_id): a repeat is 200 and appends nothing.

release_request.$comment: Seam (b): POST /v1/release. Appends the `released` event. Releasing an unheld (seat, msg_id) is 200 with held:false — the extension must be free to release optimistically after a restart without a 4xx.

register_response_with_grace.$comment: Seam (a) on the wire. The register route answers Envelope::ok("pij register", descriptor) (crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:399). `typing_grace_ms` is an ADDITIVE field on the response DATA object, flattened alongside the descriptor's snake_case fields — NOT a new field on SeatDescriptor (which would leak into seat.put rows and every registry projection). u2 defines the response wrapper in crates/core/src/wire.rs; u1 reads `accepted.typing_grace_ms`. Descriptor fields shown are the real ones from model.rs SeatDescriptor; absent Options are omitted by skip_serializing_if.

invariants.$comment: The properties every unit's tests must defend. These are the review priorities (impl-guide review.inputs).
invariants.held_is_unacked: A held row is CLAIMED but NEVER acked. Nothing may mark it delivered while held; killing the seat or the daemon must redeliver it in order on re-register (AC5).
invariants.order_preserved: Release drains in claim order — a message held at t0 is injected before one held at t0+1s.
invariants.bypass: Msg.command (compact|new|reload) and urgent payloads skip the hold entirely: inject + ack immediately, even with holds outstanding, and the held rows stay held (AC4).
invariants.one_grace: Exactly one numeric literal for the grace exists in Rust (DEFAULT_TYPING_GRACE_MS) and exactly one in TS (the `??` fallback). A test on each side asserts the observed value; a TS test asserts the wire value WINS over the fallback (AC7, risk r4).
invariants.no_false_typing: Programmatic edits (the extension's own inject/setEditorText) must not count as keystrokes — u1 ignores editor changes within 200 ms of its own write and tests it (risk r1).
invariants.no_double_delivery: A held row must not be re-delivered by the daemon's retry scheduler while held (risk r2).

receipt_note.$comment: PM finding 2026-09-05, evidence for the plan-vs-reality ruling: crates/daemon/src/delivery/mod.rs:249-251 routes Omp|Pi to DeliveryRung::Observe and :397-398 already emits Queued{reason:"extension-stream"} — the extension-stream push receipt is ALREADY queued-not-delivered on main, and flips to delivered only on delivery.inbox-ack (plan-134-live-proof.md spine rows seq 7-8, outcome reader-read). A repo-wide grep for `extension-stream` returns two hits, both inside delivery/mod.rs (:398 the producer, :1132 its own test) — risk r3's 'consumers that expected delivered' set is EMPTY. u2's receipt work is therefore a REGRESSION GUARD (a test pinning queued-before-ack / delivered-after-ack), not a behaviour change.
